nom: medicube Deep Vita C Capsule Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the cream hydrates without leaving a greasy feel, though one review notes it broke her out and another warns it may be too heavy if also sensitive.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe strong, lasting hydration and say the product suits dry skin especially well, with one calling it more of a night cream due to its thickness.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says it hydrates the dry areas while also helping the oily areas without imbalance.
segments.sensitive: Reports from self-described sensitive skin split sharply: several say it is gentle, non-irritating and even good for sensitive skin, while others with sensitive or reactive skin describe stinging, burning, small bumps or breakouts and explicitly warn sensitive-skin users to avoid or patch test first.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s and one recommending the product for her mother describe brighter, more youthful-looking skin after use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 30-45 report their skin looks brighter and more youthful after continued use, though these accounts are anecdotal and short-term.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong and lasting hydration and a plumper, glowy look; one reviewer with eczema mentions it keeps skin hydrated but had not yet seen full results.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product made her face red and rougher, alongside stinging and emerging acne; this is a minority complaint against many hydration-focused positive reports.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe stinging, pin-prick sensations, or a chemical burn-like reaction and patches resembling burns, which they attribute to the product's fragrance or actives; most other reviewers report no such barrier issues.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers, especially those noting hyperpigmentation or dark spots, report visible fading and brightening within days to a few weeks; no dissent is recorded specifically on spot-fading, though some of these same reviewers experienced unrelated breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report new breakouts, cystic acne, or tiny red bumps appearing within days to two weeks of use, sometimes requiring dermatologist treatment, while many other reviewers, including some acne-prone ones, report no breakouts and reduced acne scarring.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report the cream hydrates without adding grease or requiring reapplication, though one reviewer found it too sticky/tacky on the skin initially.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight layering under makeup or sunscreen

extraits.titre: Caused my the worst cystic acne breakout I've ever had
extraits.texte: My skin went from a pimple or a blemish here or there, to me being in the dermatologist office getting prescribed medicine to help heal my face after using this for only one week. I got SEVERE cystic acne, and scarring from this. My skin has never looked this ugly. Its all over my cheeks and chin. I hope taht my skin can hi back to what it wasbefore trying this.

I don't have sensitive skin so I'm not usually afraid to try things. Unfortunately I tried this moisturizer and another medicube product (night wrapping mask) and ultimately they are too harsh. It stings when I use the moisturizer and it has a scent which that should have been a red flag I guess. My skin is wrecked pretty good right now. It's depressing. I have some pimplies but the worst part is I have small patches that look like burns. I have a dark complexion that's usually even and I am not acne prone but I deal with hyperpigmentation. I rarely leave reviews here but I called Ulta to see what options I had for an exchange so I could get products to heal the damage cause by medicube and the person on the phone actually asked me to "submit a photo" of my breakout. I'm not comfortable doing that. I'd rather not even get the refund or credit. Just be aware and be very cautious trying this brand. Coming from somebody who doesn't ever patch test anything. PATCH. TEST. THIS.

I think I would have loved this if it didn't break me out. I used it every night for around 2 weeks, and by the 2nd week I had small bumps all over my face where I put it. This was the only change in my routine I changed so I'm pretty confident it was this product. Unfortunately I think the formula is way too heavy for my skin, no matter how much you used it never seemed to fully absorb. If you're super dry and aren't sensitive it'll probably be great, my skin was super hydrated before the breakout haha!

Get IT, RUN, this product to a tea is hands down the most hydrating thing for my combination skin type it dosent. It hydrates the dryness of my skin and helps the oily part of my skin as well, while making my acne scars dissapear. I do recommend this more for dry skin though!

I struggle so much with my skin, acne, too oily, too dry, you name it! I have been using the same 2 products my derm recommend for 5 years and decided to give this a try after reading the ingredients. This has changed my skin! My face is so hydrated but not oily, so glowy, and so smooth! It hasnt made me breakout which most things do! Its a great price for what the product delivers. The only thing i struggle with is getting the ratios correct, its hard to not grab too much gel when trying to get to the capsule, but with some minor tweaking, it worls out!

extraits.titre: My Intro To Medicube- Will Repurchase
extraits.texte: I was honestly hesitant to buy anything from this brand because it's heavily promoted on TikTok, and I don't usually take influencer reviews too seriously. I know a lot of them are focused on selling rather than giving a genuine opinion. That said, I've been using the Vitamin C Capsule Cream religiously in my morning routine since the end of December, and I've been really impressed. I have normal skin that leans oily, and I just turned 30. I also have some mild hyperpigmentation from not being diligent with sunscreen in my early 20s. The texture of this product is beautiful. Lightweight but still hydrating. It layers perfectly with the rest of my skincare and doesn't pill under sunscreen or makeup, which is huge for me. I also have sensitive skin and was nervous to try another Vitamin C because past ones either broke me out or irritated my skin (Sunday Riley's was the worst for me). Thankfully, this one hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. Overall, I've noticed my skin tone looks more even, and my texture feels smoother. I love the glow. For me, this has genuinely been a great find.

Amazing product! After purchasing for my mom i saw instant brightening results and more youful looking skin. It wasnt until i ran out of my usual face cream that i tried hers for a few days and saw instant results for myself!! I have oily, acne prone skin. This is incredibly hydrating, without making me greasy OR feel like i need to reapply. And this truly brightens like crazy!!! You wont regret buying!!
